$comment: Semantic fact namespace (Posudek 17, 15. 9. 2026): WHAT a key means, never its value. This is the shared vocabulary the per-module sidecars (src/components/<module>/facts.json) consume and produce, so a deterministic planner can chain capabilities without ever reading business data (SEVERKA 'Hlavni invariant: farmar nesmi nosit hodnoty'). kind: fact = a business value the platform holds in an artifact/result and passes by reference | artifact = a stored object (Artifact/IncomingArtifact) | evidence = an append-only Zlab record attesting one fact's value (Evidence.inputField/inputValueHash/result), named by 'for' | effect = a side effect in the outside world. authority (facts only): source = read from the document itself | derived = resolved from another system (registry, ERP). scope (facts only): which 'many'-multiplicity entity (below) this fact is per-instance of; absent = the reserved case scope (one value per Case). An entry never carries an example value on purpose — FactCatalog.build() refuses any field outside the contract (FACT-001).

facts.description: Superseded by impulse.raw (M0-FACT-CONTRACT-V1.md část 0, krůček 5) — mail.ingest now consumes impulse.raw. Kept, unreferenced, for history; never deleted (append-only dictionary, same discipline as the Žlab).
Superseded by impulse.sender — mail.ingest now produces impulse.sender. Kept, unreferenced, for history.
Superseded by impulse.subject — mail.ingest now produces impulse.subject. Kept, unreferenced, for history.

The normalized impulse's own raw payload, whatever the channel (SEVERKA 'Impuls, Case a neomezeny vstup', M0-FACT-CONTRACT-V1.md cast 0). mail.ingest consumes this today (renamed from mail.raw) — still no producer of its own (boundary-fed by the mail transport, same as mail.raw always was), a real ingress adapter is M2.

Where the impulse arrived from (mail, telegram, slack, web, upload, api, ...) — never itself a decision input for workflow/intent/goal (the hard invariant: channel carries the impulse, never its meaning). No producer yet — mail.ingest does not stamp it (M2 ingress adapters will).
Sender as declared by the channel — untrusted, never an identity. Produced by mail.ingest today (renamed from mail.sender).
Subject/title as declared by the channel, when it has one. Produced by mail.ingest today (renamed from mail.subject).
Free-text body of the impulse, when it has one (a chat message, an email body, a form's free-text field).
Content hash of one attachment — identityFields member: re-normalizing the same impulse keeps the same entityId iff both sha256 and name are unchanged.
Filename of one attachment as declared by the channel — identityFields member alongside sha256 (two different files can share a name, never a hash).

What the impulse means, resolved by intent.resolve (src/components/intent-resolver/, 19.9.2026) from an impulse-content artifact. Includes UNKNOWN as a valid value: 'we don't know what this is' is a state the platform must represent, not an error.

intent.resolve's sealed evidence for impulse.intent (src/components/intent-resolver/, 19.9.2026), CASE_SCOPE — sealed unconditionally on every call that reaches SUCCEEDED, UNKNOWN included, never gated like document.type.invoiceConfirmed. Vocabulary is the first fixed set (docs/AUTONOMOUS-RUNTIME-V1.md line 181's own illustrative list); extending it is a schema version bump, never a silent code change.
The original document artifact: web upload, mail body/attachment, ISDOC, scan. sha256-addressed, immutable.

INVOICE / CONTRACT / OTHER as classified (document.classify output documentType). Deliberately LEFT CASE_SCOPE (P0 fact-scope-multi-doc pass, 18.9.2026 — contrast document.type.invoiceConfirmed above, rescoped to impulse.attachment in this same change): this key is the live, load-bearing singleton the whole-mail stamp/archive/notify pipeline reads — document-validator/facts.json, document-executor-host/facts.json and email-executor/facts.json all consume plain 'document.type', and workflows/mail-intake.v3.json's untouched validate→stamp→notify steps thread its value straight through by "$steps.classify/validate.payload.documentType" with no entityId concept anywhere in that chain. Rescoping it would break every one of those live consumers for a gap (>1 document per Case) that ADR part 8's acceptance scenario C only actually exercises through the fan-out/attachment-classify path (document.type.invoiceConfirmed), never through this top-level singleton — mail-intake.v3.json's own top-level classify step classifies the WHOLE mail once, by design, same as before this change.

document.validate's second, independent signal over the classified type (stampAllowed). Consumed by every write that depends on the type. Deliberately LEFT CASE_SCOPE, same reasoning as document.type just above (P0 fact-scope-multi-doc pass, 18.9.2026): document-executor-host/facts.json's document.stamp genuinely consumes this exact key, unentitied, as part of the same untouched mail-intake.v3.json pipeline — nothing about the >1-document-per-Case gap this change closes (document.type.invoiceConfirmed only) requires touching it.

document.classify's own sealed evidence that THIS artifact classified as INVOICE — its handler writes this evidence only when the result actually was INVOICE, never for CONTRACT/OTHER (owner's Commit 1, M0-FACT-CONTRACT-V1.md část C authority-gate pattern, 18.9.2026). invoice.extract consumes this key, not document.type itself, so a contract or a photo can never reach extraction. Deliberately NOT declared as a 'produces' key in any module's facts.json (contrast document.type.validated, which document-validator's facts.json does declare producing, because passing validation is not conditioned on one specific business value): a value-conditional gate like this one must never be something plan() can chain its way into producing from a bare document.original — src/platform/attachment-fanout.ts discovers it per artifact from the Žlab after actually running document.classify, never from the static catalog (tests/plan.test.ts PLAN-007 proves the catalog alone refuses it). scope: impulse.attachment, added by the P0 fact-scope-multi-doc pass (docs/AUTONOMOUS-RUNTIME-V1.md část 2, this change, 18.9.2026 external audit): before this, the evidence's own subject was hardcoded CASE_SCOPE (document-classifier/handler.ts's old seal()), so attachment-fanout.ts's classifiedAsInvoice() could not disambiguate this evidence by FactAddress alone and instead keyed the lookup on Evidence.workflowId — a live-correct but load-bearing coincidence of 'one classify sub-instance per attachment' that would have silently broken the moment a second, non-workflow-keyed producer of this evidence existed (the ADR's own acceptance scenario C, část 8: a mail with a contract + an invoice + an ordinary photo, i.e. already more than one document per Case, is exactly the shape CurrentCaseProjection (část 4, TARGET, not built by this change) will need to read Case-scoped evidence per document — it cannot do that if the fact's own scope claims to be one-per-Case while more than one is genuinely sealed). Rescoping to the already-declared 'many' entity impulse.attachment (this file's own entities[0]) makes THIS evidence's FactAddress alone (key+scope+entityId) the correct, sufficient identity — no workflowId keying needed — without touching FactCatalog.build()'s validation at all (a fact/evidence's own 'scope' need not match its 'for' target's scope; tests/facts.test.ts pins this structurally). document.type and document.type.validated (below) are deliberately LEFT CASE_SCOPE, not rescoped alongside this one — see their own entries for why.
Retention derived from the validated type (document.validate output retentionDays).
Stamped copy of the original (document.stamp output stampedArtifactId).
Stamped document written to the DMS (document.stamp output dmsRef).
Original written to the archive (document.archive output archiveRef).
Allowlisted recipient reference (email.send input recipientRef) — a reference, never a raw address.
Notification handed to SMTP (email.send output smtpMessageId).
ICO as printed on the invoice (invoice.v1 supplier.companyId; invoice.extract output companyId).
cz.company.verify against the ARES register, sealed into the Zlab with inputField companyId.
Registered name as returned by ARES (cz.company.verify output companyName).
DIC as printed on the invoice (invoice.v1 supplier.vatId). No producer today: invoice.extract v1 extracts four fields and this is not one of them.
cz.vat.verify against the tax administration's VAT payer register, sealed with inputField vatId; result = the published reliability flag as-is.
Payer name as returned by the VAT register (cz.vat.verify output companyName) — a different register than ARES, hence a different key.
Bank accounts published for the VAT payer (cz.vat.verify output publishedAccounts) — the Import Gate's ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION source.
Bank account as printed on the invoice (invoice.extract output bankAccount).
Invoice number as issued by the supplier (invoice.extract output invoiceNumber; BC vendorInvoiceNumber).
Total including VAT (invoice.extract output totalWithVat).

Business Central Vendor No. — the one field erp.post cannot send without (docs/BC-PURCHASE-INVOICE-POLE.md). No producer today: bc.vendors is SEVERKA ## Poradi item 7, not built. Derived, never extractable from an invoice.
